test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: The 16th Finance Commission has recommended a disaster management corpus of Rs 2,04,401 crore for State Disaster Relief and Management Funds (SDRF and SDMF). What is the recommended cost-sharing ratio between the Centre and States for North-Eastern and Himalayan states, and for all other states respectively?
solution:
The correct answer is __**90:10 and 75:25.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 16th Finance Commission (FC-16) report, tabled on February 1, 2026, outlined the funding mechanism for disaster management across Indian states.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Commission recommended a total disaster management corpus of Rs 2,04,401 crore for the SDRF and SDMF.**
 
• For North-Eastern and Himalayan states, the cost-sharing ratio between the Centre and the States is 90:10.
 
• For all other states, the cost-sharing ratio is set at 75:25.
 
• Of the total corpus, the Centre’s share is calculated to be Rs 1,55,916 crore.
 
• Disaster Management Funding (FC-16)__
 __
 
• Total Corpus - Rs 2,04,401 crore
 
• Centre's Total Share - Rs 1,55,916 crore
 
• NE & Himalayan States Ratio - 90:10
 
• Other States Ratio - 75:25
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• SDRF (State Disaster Response Fund)__

 __
 
• Primary fund available with states for responses to notified disasters to meet expenditure for providing immediate relief.
 
 
 
• SDMF (State Disaster Mitigation Fund)__
 __
 
• Funds specifically earmarked for projects aimed at reducing the impact or risk of future disasters.
 
 
 
• North-Eastern and Himalayan States__
 __
 
• These include states like Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, etc., which often face higher geological and climate risks.
 
 
 
• Article 275__
 
 
• The provision under which the Parliament provides grants-in-aid to the states as per the recommendations of the Finance Commission.
